architectural_notes: Time values for exercises should be calculated based on calendar months (not user progression months).
Plank time should increase by +15 seconds each calendar month from a defined base (e.g., Feb 1:15, Mar 1:30, Apr 1:45).
Squash time should remain fixed at 45 minutes for every calendar month (no increments).
known_issues: Bug: Plank time is displaying/calculating incorrectly (March is much higher than February; should increase by exactly +15 seconds per calendar month).
Bug: Squash time is not staying constant at 45 minutes each calendar month.

existing_features.title: Fix the monthly progression logic so that the habit named "Plank" (time unit) increases by exactly +15 seconds per calendar month (e.g., February 1:15, March 1:30, April 1:45), and the habit named "Squash" (time unit) remains constant at 45:00 for every calendar month. Do not change progression behavior for other habits.

Update the frontend’s optimistic volume compounding (used during volume edits) to match the corrected calendar-month rules for Plank (+15 seconds/month) and Squash (constant 45:00 across all months), while leaving other habits unchanged.

new_feature_requests.summary: Ensure time-based volume updates correctly preserve and/or initialize unit type as "time" so that time habits (including Plank and Squash) never compound using the default "reps" rules when a timeString is provided during an update.

projectName: Fix monthly time progression: Plank +15s per calendar month; Squash constant 45:00
